title: Get the tests in a form you can run
statement: As a developer, I can get any list of end-to-end tests in a form my test runner accepts, so I, or an agent, can run exactly those tests straight away.
overview: This fills a real gap: `review test-plan` has a `commands` list, but it only returns commands from deprecated run records. This Saga has none, so every test it selected across three merged reviews reported `missing_command`. The declaring line matters: tried on this repository, `playwright test --list` finds 1 test for `pull-request-review.spec.ts:52`, the `test()` line, and 0 for line 55, inside its body. A runner that selects by name can start from the JSON.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `--format json` gives each test's case, path and declaring line as data.
`--format locations` prints one `path:line` per test, using the line that declares it, resolved at the code being asked about.
`--format command` fills in the Saga's command template with those locations.
In this repository, running the printed command makes Playwright run the listed tests and no others.
A listed test with no declaring line is named as not runnable in every format, and is never silently left out.
Asking for a command with no template is refused and names the command that sets one.
